title: cananga sellowiana
intro: Cananga sellowiana, commonly known as Ylang-Ylang, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Cananga genus and is native to the Philippines and Indonesia. The essential oil extracted from its flowers is known for its numerous health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation and sleep, and acting as an antiseptic to aid in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Ylang-Ylang oil include its sedative, antidepressant, and anticonvulsant properties, making it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy. The bioactive constituents of Ylang-Ylang oil include sesquiterpenes, including beta-eudesmol and farnesol, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
